description: Spring Boot 4 / Java 21+ services: build, data access, testing, security review, and the container and cluster around them.

skills: | [spring-boot]({{DIR_SKILLS}}/spring-boot.md) | building or changing a Spring Boot service: controllers, configuration, REST clients, error handling, observability, packaging |
| [spring-data-jpa]({{DIR_SKILLS}}/spring-data-jpa.md) | Spring Data JPA or Hibernate work: entities, repositories, queries, transactions, schema migrations, N+1 and fetch problems |
| [spring-testing]({{DIR_SKILLS}}/spring-testing.md) | writing or fixing Spring Boot tests: slices, MockMvc, Testcontainers with service connections, mocking beans |
agents: | [spring-boot-engineer]({{DIR_AGENTS}}/spring-boot-engineer.md) | a Spring Boot feature or service must be implemented end to end in a Java codebase |
| [spring-reviewer]({{DIR_AGENTS}}/spring-reviewer.md) | a Spring Boot change needs a framework-aware review: layering, transactions, JPA, configuration, test slices |
| [spring-security]({{DIR_AGENTS}}/spring-security.md) | a Spring Security change (filter chain, method security, OAuth2/JWT, CORS/CSRF) needs a security pass |
| [kubernetes-specialist]({{DIR_AGENTS}}/kubernetes-specialist.md) | a Spring Boot service needs Kubernetes manifests, probes, resources or a rollout strategy reviewed or written |
| [docker-expert]({{DIR_AGENTS}}/docker-expert.md) | a Spring Boot service needs a Dockerfile, layered or native image, or container build reviewed or written |
| [devops-engineer]({{DIR_AGENTS}}/devops-engineer.md) | a Spring Boot service needs its build and delivery pipeline reviewed or improved, on whatever CI the project already uses |
